mLocKeys.keyTooltip: This unit will be stunned if it reaches 3 stacks of Mark of the Storm.
Kennen's next attack will deal bonus damage and add a Mark of the Storm.
This unit will receive a reduced stun if stunned by Kennen again.

mLocKeys.keySummary: Kennen marks enemies when hitting them with abilities. Once three marks are applied the target is stunned.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Kennen's abilities add Mark of the Storm to opponents for @MarkDuration@ seconds. Upon receiving 3 Mark of Storm, an opponent is Stunned for @StunDuration@ seconds and Kennen receives 25 Energy.

If the same target is Stunned again with Mark of the Storm within @DiminishingReturnDuration@ seconds the target is Stunned for @ReducedStunDuration@ seconds instead.
Kennen will do extra damage and add a Mark of the Storm to his opponent every 5 attacks.
This unit is a flippin' Ninja.
Kennen has additional movement speed, is ghosted, and will deal damage to any enemy he touches.

mLocKeys.keySummary: Kennen morphs into a lightning form, enabling him to pass through units.  Any enemy unit he runs through takes damage and gets a Mark of the Storm.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Kennen turns into a ball of lightning gaining @MovementSpeed*100@% Move Speed, dealing @TotalDamage@ magic damage to any enemy he passes through, and becomes Ghosted for @DurationAsBall@ seconds. Additionally, Kennen will gain @Resists@ Armor and @Resists@ Magic Resist for @ResistancesDuration@ seconds.

Kennen is refunded @EnergyRefund@ Energy if he passes through an enemy, but can only gain this effect once. This ability deals half damage to minions (@TotalMinionDamage@).
mLocKeys.keyTooltipExtendedBelowLine: <rules>Ghosted units ignore collision with other units.</rules>

mLocKeys.keySummary: Kennen throws a fast moving shuriken towards a location, causing damage and adding a Mark of Storm to any opponent that it hits.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip: Kennen throws a shuriken that damages the first enemy hit dealing <magicDamage>@TotalDamage@ magic damage</magicDamage>.

mLocKeys.keySummary: Kennen summons a storm that strikes at random nearby enemy champions for magical damage.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip: Summons a magical storm for @Jade_KennenRDuration@ seconds, dealing <magicDamage>@PerTickDamageCalculated@ magic damage</magicDamage> to a random enemy champion near Kennen every @Jade_KennenRTickRate@ seconds. This storm cannot hit the same target more than @MaximumHitsPerCast@ times.

mLocKeys.keySummary: Kennen passively deals extra damage and adds a Mark of the Storm to his target every few attacks, and he can activate this ability to damage and add another Mark of the Storm to targets who are already marked.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Passive: Every @PassiveHitsRequired@ attacks, Kennen deals @TotalDamagePassive@ magic damage and adds a Mark of the Storm to his target.

Active: Surges electricity through all nearby targets afflicted by Mark of the Storm, dealing @TotalDamageActive@ magic damage.
